supplements.description: Negotiated per-account price ladders for the largest enterprise accounts, maintained by account management outside the product. Rows here override dim_rate_tier for that account and SKU while effective; forge carries them verbatim and enforces no reference.

descriptions.account_id: dim_account.account_id the ladder belongs to (ACC-#####); not checked against the warehouse.

descriptions.effective_to: Last day the ladder applies (inclusive); empty while still in force.
descriptions.from_units: Inclusive lower bound of cumulative monthly volume the band applies to.
descriptions.ordinal: Position of the band within its ladder, from 1 upward; restarts at 1 in each effective window.
descriptions.pct_of_list: Percent of dim_sku.standard_rate charged inside the band, replacing the account's pct_of_list_rate; empty when the row carries a rate.
descriptions.rate: Negotiated price per unit (USD) inside the band; empty when the row is priced as pct_of_list instead.
descriptions.sku_id: dim_sku.sku_id the ladder prices (SKU-###); not checked against the warehouse.
descriptions.to_units: Inclusive upper bound of the band; empty on the open-ended top band.

scenario_description: A B2B SaaS vendor over five years, emitted as billing inputs rather than invoices: companies sign up on a plan tier and provision a hub of seats, their users cycle weekly between using the product and sitting idle, and a repeating renewal review renegotiates the account's seat price, usage discount, committed spend and allowance — or ends it — while a follow-up review sometimes issues a credit. The rate card (plan terms, graduated per-SKU tiers, flat add-ons) and the dated free-usage promotions are data the invoice query joins to; no billed amount is ever stored.
